$comment: Registered deviations from SAPUI5 1.154.0 (docs/30 §6, ADR-033 §5). module "*" applies to every module. Categories: kit-extension, not-implemented (with stage), react-idiom, no-binding, different-value, fe-behavior (with stage). Maintained by hand; npm run check:ui5 -- --baseline / --prune help.
